parent_objective: implement deterministic bounded non-holdout source selector and emit source-only materialization subset
blocked_by: M1925 defines the panel design but no selector or subset artifact exists
supersedes: manual source selection from the 399 supported source pool

public_gates: M1926 must select exactly 80 supported non-holdout sources
M1926 must select exactly 4 sources for every feasibility-tier and role cell
M1926 must select exactly 2 steady and 2 post-friction sources for every tier-role cell
M1926 must write a source-only subset artifact and summary without reset rollout measured execution or ranking
M1926 must keep controller-family ranking paper claims and level3 self-ID blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the audited source-support table into a bounded executable-panel source subset
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-only materialization artifact; no reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout controller ranking paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if exact 80-source non-holdout selection fails
stop if any holdout row is selected
stop if exact tier-role or surface balance is impossible
stop if implementation would require threshold tuning
fallback_plan: route to materialization command design if selector passes
route to source-template repair if exact balance fails
route to branch synthesis if non-holdout support is too brittle

admission_evidence: M1925 defines an 80-source non-holdout selection protocol and 960-cell planned workload target
blocked_shortcuts: do not run reset rollout measured execution
do not train or run PPO
allowed_updates: M1926 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for materialization command design or source-template repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; source-subset materialization does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M1926.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1924 audited support and M1925 materialization design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If exact selection fails, record it as scenario-quality evidence and repair/synthesize before controller comparison.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates the first bounded executable-panel source subset for the task-quality branch
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit reset/materialization command design but cannot change driver verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M1926 cannot produce an exact non-holdout balanced subset
M1926 would allow ranking before reset/measured gates

hypothesis: The M1925 deterministic selector can create an 80-source balanced non-holdout subset from M1924 supported sources.
success_criteria: selected_source_count_per_tier_role is 4 for all 20 tier-role cells
surface balance is 2 steady and 2 post-friction for every tier-role cell
no reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claim is made
failure_criteria: reset rollout measured execution training replay or PPO is run
controller ranking or paper-level claims are made
decision_rule: M1926 passes if it creates an exact balanced non-holdout source subset and summary with clean guardrails and no rollout or ranking.
